title: PLIANT THERAPEUTICS, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: Pliant Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing three board member departures (David E.I. Pyott, Katharine Knobil, and Suzanne Bruhn) effective at the 2026 Annual Meeting, and approved a repricing of underwater stock options to $1.33 per share with retention requirements. This is a company-specific corporate governance and executive compensation filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Three directors (Pyott, Knobil, Bruhn) retiring/not seeking reelection at 2026 Annual Meeting; no disagreements cited
Board approved option repricing effective April 17, 2026 to $1.33 per share (closing price on Nasdaq)
Repricing applies to all options granted on or before March 1, 2025 under three equity plans
Eligible participants must remain employed through retention period (18 months for executives, 12 months for others)
Named executive officers affected: Bernard Coulie (CEO), Keith Cummings (CFO), Lily Cheung (CHRO), Minnie Kuo (COO)
Company is Pliant Therapeutics (PLRX), a biopharmaceutical firm based in South San Francisco
